svg.title: Thus zero same-insertion covariance is a conclusion after removing the regulator. It is not an identity for a finite torus. Here is the averaging step that identifies both limits. Let S be the finite group of signed coordinate transformations and cS = |S|−1. For a jet functional A, its averaged lattice stencil has the exact form A(wideLinearh,x) = cS X s∈S A ◦turns ◦radialMap(charts,h,x). (PT22)
